title: Technical Lead - Technical Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and provide L2 support for Value Added Services (VAS) platforms, primarily SMSC and USSD.
* Manage production incidents, perform impact assessment, lead incident bridge calls, and ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and drive preventive and corrective actions.
* Perform system administration and troubleshooting on Linux servers.
* Develop and execute basic to intermediate automation scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to improve operational efficiency.
* Execute basic database administration and troubleshooting activities on MySQL and Oracle databases.
* Monitor application health, system performance, and service availability while proactively identifying potential risks.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Customer Support teams for issue resolution, deployments, and change management activities.
* Support software upgrades, patch deployments, and production releases while ensuring minimal business impact.
* Maintain operational documentation, incident reports, and knowledge base articles.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL processes, operational governance, and customer SLAs.
* Demonstrate a basic understanding of GSM network elements and their interaction with telecom applications.
* Possess working knowledge of Operating System Virtualization concepts to support virtualized environments.


**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**
* VAS Platforms: SMSC, USSD
* Operating Systems: Linux
* Incident Management: Incident handling, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Production support
* Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell (Basic to Intermediate)
* Databases: MySQL, Oracle (Basic to Intermediate)
* Telecom: Basic knowledge of GSM architecture and network elements
* Virtualization: Basic understanding of OS virtualization technologies

title: ERP Executive (Fashion Industry)
description:
A
 **handbags and accessories manufacturer and exporter** 
 is hiring for the profile of
 **ERP Executive.** 




  





**Location** 
 : Manesar
 



  





**Experience:** 
 1\-4 years
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 The ERP Admin Executive is responsible for managing, maintaining, and supporting the organization’s Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. This role ensures smooth system
 



 operations, user support, data accuracy, and coordination between departments to optimize
 



 business processes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  Administer and maintain the ERP system on a daily basis
 



  Manage user roles, access controls, and security permissions
 



  Monitor system performance and troubleshoot technical issues
 



  Provide support and training to end\-users across departments
 



  Coordinate with IT teams or vendors for system upgrades, patches, and enhancements
 



  Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and timely updates in the system
 



  Generate reports and dashboards for management as required
 



  Assist in ERP implementation, customization, and integration projects
 



  Document system processes, workflows, and troubleshooting guides
 



  Identify opportunities for process improvements within ERP usage
 



  Centralize Item codes generation responsibility
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




  Bachelor’s degree
 



  1–4 years of experience in ERP administration/support
 



  Familiarity with ERP systems
 



  Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
 



  Good communication and interpersonal skills
 



  Ability to work with cross\-functional team
 



  Experience in ERP implementation or migration projects
 



  Understanding of business processes (Production, SCM, Stores, Merchandizing, PD etc)
 



  Knowledge of data security and compliance practices

title: Digital Engineer
description:

title: IT Manager-Operations( ERP Finsay)
description:
**Job Summary**
 To manage the company's complete IT operations and ensure smooth functioning of ERP, computer systems, network, CCTV and IT support services.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage and support ERP Finsys and resolve user queries/issues.
* Manage all office computers, laptops, printers and software.
* Maintain LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet and networking systems.
* Manage and troubleshoot CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR and recording systems.
* Provide day\-to\-day IT support to all employees.
* Maintain IT assets, user IDs, access permissions and data backups.
* Coordinate with ERP, CCTV, hardware and other IT vendors.
* Ensure IT security, system availability and minimum downtime.
* Maintain proper records of IT complaints, assets, AMC and services.


 Qualification \& Experience
   

  

* Graduate/Diploma/BCA/B.Tech/MCA in IT or Computer Science.
* 5\-8 years of relevant IT experience.
* Experience in ERP, hardware, networking and CCTV preferred.


 Key Skills
   

  

 ERP Finsys \| IT Infrastructure \| Hardware \& Software \| Networking \| CCTV \| IT Support \| Data Backup \| Vendor Management \| IT Security
